ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Researchers in the Southwest are studying tortoises-a species of animal that is affected by habitat loss due to human development of the desert. A total of 78 tortoises are being studied by researchers at several sites. The data on gender and species of all these tortoises is organized in the table shown below. If a tortoise from this study is to be selected at random, let A = the tortoise is femaleand B = the tortoise is a Morafka. Which of the following appropriately interprets the value of P(B|A)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: 31.3% is the probability that a randomly selected female tortoise is a Morafka tortoise.
